chunks: My father, may Allah have mercy on him, said: We were told by Muhammad ibn Abi al-Qasim, from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Kufi, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, who said: We were at the place of Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him),
a man recited: "Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Falaq". Then the man said: What is the Falaq?

He said: A cut in the Fire in which there are seventy thousand houses, in every house there are seventy thousand rooms, in every room there are seventy thousand lions, in the inside of every lion there are seventy thousand jars of poison which the people of the Fire must pass by.

key_terms.أَهْلِ النَّارِ: The people of the Fire (inhabitants of Hell)
key_terms.الْفَلَقُ: The splitting or dawn; here interpreted as a specific location in Hell
key_terms.صُدْعٌ: A cut, split, or deep division

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Al-Falaq' in Surah Al-Falaq according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) offers a unique cosmological interpretation of 'Al-Falaq' as a specific fissure in Hellfire rather than the dawn mentioned in the Surah's title. The description employs the Shia scholarly motif of 'seven times seven' multiplicities to emphasize the vastness of the punishment, detailing a hierarchy of seventy thousand dwellings, rooms, and lions, each containing jars of venom that the damned must pass through.

en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Muhammed bin Abi’l-Qasem, from Muhammed bin Ali al-Kufi, from Uthman bin Isa, from Mu’awiya bin Wahab, that he said: We were at the place of Abu Abdillah, peace be upon him,
and a man recited: «Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the falaq» [113:1]. Then the man said: What is the falaq?

He said: A cut in the Fire in which there are seventy countries, in every country there are sevent thousand houses, in every house there are seventy thousand snakes, in the inside of every snake there are seventy thousand jars of poison which the people of the Fire must pass by.
